name: Survival Pulse
niche: New survival and everyday-carry gear checked against its spec sheet: what is worth the money this year
audience: 18-40, budget-aware, new to prepping and the outdoors, mostly watching on a phone
tone: Fast, direct and friendly. Short sentences, one clear verdict per product, no hype words
pillars: Best X under a price, ranked
Two popular picks head to head
Myth vs reality of viral gear
ctaStyle: Mid-video, one line pointing to the comparison at the end; at the end, ask which match-up to test next
rules: Reviews, specs and legal use only
No instructions for modifying, converting or building firearms
Never show or describe shooting at people or animals
